Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan just couldn't withstand the Sri Lankan force. From the middle order, only Sohail played some innings of substance. He looked at ease when playing the waiting game and so did he when he had to attack. But sadly for the youngster as well as the hosts, he had nobody for company. Their openers gave them a steady start, but they failed to capitalize on that. Azhar Ali played yet another good knock, but his innings failed to reach the heights it promised. Now they will walk out to try and restrict the visitors to as less as possible in a bid to try and stay relevant in the game. Remember, Amir isn't available to bowl, which is a blow for them. Stay with us to know how the following innings pans out!

Follow-on is not enforced by Sri Lanka! The tourists would be very happy with their performance, albeit a bit weary due to the number of overs they had to spend out on the field. What would please them to no ends is the fact that Herath had just a supporting role to play. Although he and Perera picked up three wickets apiece, their pacers were instrumental in this. They offered freebies at a premium which helped the side. They would now look to bat well in order to give their bowlers a deserving break for them to come back with great vigor in the next innings. With the position they are in, it's their game to lose from hereon!

OUT! Bowled 'em! The slower one does it for Sri Lanka. Lakmal rolls his fingers over the ball, lands it on middle. Yasir Shah is deceived by it as he wildly slogs across the line. The ball beats the bat and shatters the leg stump. That's the end of the Pakistan innings! THEY ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 262, TRAILING BY 220 RUNS!
Once again Yasir Shah tries to slog it across the line but gets an inside edge on the pads. Lakmal gives him a stare as he walks back.

SIX! That's cracked off the meat of the bat! What a crackling sound it made, ahhh! Back of a length ball on middle, Yasir Shah backs away and bludgeons it over deep square leg for a maximum all the way.
Fuller length delivery on middle and leg, kept out towards mid on.
Slower ball outside off, pushed into the cover region for a single.
FOUR! Cracked it! Shortish ball on middle, Shah backs away and swats it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep fumbles and the ball trickles away to the fence.
Short again and angling in, Abbas fends it awkwardly down to fine leg for a single.
Mohammad Abbas is the last man in!
Drinks are on the field...

OUT! The decision is overturned! Excellent captaincy from Chandimal. He shows aggression. Brings in a short leg fielder just before this ball and it has worked wonders for him. Gamage hits the deck hard, Riaz is completely into a tangle as he doesn't know how to deal with it. The ball pops off something to Sadeera Samarawickrama at short leg who takes the catch. Sri Lanka appeal but Kettleborough shakes his head. Chandimal is confident that it has taken some part of the gloves and so takes the review. Snicko shows some spike as the ball passes the gloves. It's enough for the TV umpire to ask the on-field umpire to change his decision. Pakistan still 33 behind to avoid the follow-on.
The ball lobs off something to the short leg fielder. Chandimal feels it has come off the gloves and hence takes the review...
Short leg in place now. We can expect some short stuff now.
Fuller and swinging back in, worked through mid on for a single.
No ball! Length delivery outside off, Yasir Shah keeps his bat inside the line and leaves it alone. The umpire stretches his right hand to to call it a no ball as Gamage oversteps.
Spills once again down the leg side, it brushes his pads and rolls towards the left of Dickwella behind.
Fuller on the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side. They come back for a brace.
Beaten! Drops it on a length and gets it to shape away from the batsman. Riaz tries poking at it, is beaten.
Length delivery outside off, cut square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, Shah pushes it away from his body. Goes straight to the man at cover.
Angles it in on middle, worked with the angle towards mid on for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, tapped towards point for a single.
Sprays it down the leg side, Wahab looks to help it on its way but fails to do so. A good take from the keeper behind.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Riaz slashes at it and gets beaten.
Gamage hits the deck hard, generates good amount of bounce. Riaz ducks ti evade it.
Not an ideal length to have a go but Riaz decides to free his arms. Slams it hard but couldn't get it past the man at covers.
Good length delivery in the line of the stumps, stabbed off the back foot.
Lahiru Gamage is brought into the attack as well. He was the one who drew first blood this morning. Can he wrap the tail up now?
Fuller and wider outside off, YS has got nothing to do with that one.
Spears it further up, gets it to swing away. Shah goes chasing after it only to get beaten.
Angles it in on middle, a bit too straight and as a result Riaz flicks it through mid-wicket to collect one.
Pitches it up, searching for the swing. Riaz leans ahead and drives it through covers for a couple.
Good length delivery, moving away a bit, this time it's defended well.

Riaz is opened up completely! Waqar Younis on-air is really happy with Sri Lanka's decision to take the new ball. The lights have taken effect and the ball will surely move around, he reckons. This ball is a perfect example. Lakmal from over the wicket, lands it on a length on off, Riaz tries to defend but the ball swings away late to beat him all ends up.
It's Suranga Lakmal who will have a go with the new cherry from the other end. Three slips and a gully in place.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

SIX! In the air... clears the man at long on! Sees the flight, Yasir Shah dances down the track and tries to go big down the ground. Mistimes it high in the air but had enough meat to clear Pradeep at long on. A maximum for the leggie!
Floated delivery outside off, swept through square leg for a single.
Brings his bat and pad close to keep it out.
Slows it through the air outside off, dabbed past first slip for one.
Quicker ball on middle, skidding a bit, Yasir is quick to bring his bat down.
Sri Lanka have opted for the second new ball! Chandimal and Herath had a chat with each other during the break and it seemed like the veteran convinced his skipper to take the new cherry.
On middle and leg, worked through square leg for a single.

This time it's Yasir Shah who sinks low and sweeps it uppishly towards deep backward square leg. The call is for two and they get it easily. The throw was at the wrong end, the bowler's end. Had it been at the keeper's, things would have been interesting.
Flighted delivery outside off, turns in a bit, Shah has all the time in the world to deal with it.
Goes back and blocks it off the front foot gently.
Loopy delivery outside off, turning in, Riaz gets down and brings out his sweep shot. It lands near deep backward square leg and they get a single.
Loopy delivery outside off, Yasir Shah steps out and drives it uppishly towards cover.
Darts it full on off, WR comes forward to defend but the ball catches an inside edge and hits him on the pads.
Bowls an arm ball, skidding off the surface, Riaz misses his flick and is hit on the pads. They appeal, but it was going down leg.
Pushes it quicker through the air on middle, Riaz shows a straight bat.
FOUR! Floats it up outside off, Wahab Riaz gets down and smokes it against the turn over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Quicker one on off, stays a bit low, Riaz crouches low and cuts it towards the point fielder. Wants the single but is sent back.
Fires it on off, Riaz jams it out back to the bowler.
Gets down does Riaz and sweeps it off the inner half behind square on the leg side to keep strike.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Quicker through the air on middle, Wahab hangs back in defense.
Gets well forward and blocks it into the ground.
Edged and away! Goes over the wicket and tosses it up outside off, it comes in as Riaz goes back to defend. Gets an outside edge which rolls past first slip. They get a couple.
Wahab Riaz walks in next!

OUT! Another one bites the dust! The danger man, Haris Sohail is shown the way to the pavilion! Sri Lanka are absolutely delighted! Perera from around the wicket, hits the rough outside off, Sohail leans ahead to defend but the ball skids through and hits him on the pads. Looked dead close to the naked eye! Perera appeals and the umpire has no qualms in raising his finger. Now then, Pakistan are still 63 away to avoid the follow-on!
Slows it through the air, served outside off, Yasir lunges forward to push it away but does so a bit uppishly towards cover.
Gives it a nice loop around off, Shah stonewalls it.
Flighted delivery outside off, Shah lunges forward in defense.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Shot! Nicely tossed up outside off, Haris Sohail gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it dead straight down the ground. The umpire did well to get out of the firing line and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Loopy ball outside off, Sohail goes back and defends.
Leans forward and works it wide of the man at mid on for a single.
Keeps it full on the stumps, blocked watchfully.
HS has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter and quicker through the air outside off, defended off the back foot.
Comes down track to defend but misses and is hit on the pads.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Sohail is solid in defense.
Yasir Shah is the next man in!

OUT! The on-field call stays! Herath continues to chip away at the wickets! The veteran tosses it up outside off, Amir lunges forward to defend but the ball turns back in to ping him on the front pad right in front of the stumps. Sri Lanka go up in unison and umpire Kettleborough raises his dreaded finger. Amir takes the review. Replays roll in, impact is umpire's call and it would have gone on to hit the middle stump. That's it for Amir. Pakistan need 69 more to avoid the follow-on.
A loud shout for LBW and umpire Kettleborough after a thought raises his finger. Amir takes the review...
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Loopy ball outside off, driven towards the fielder at mid off.

Fifty up for Haris Sohail! Once again he is playing a vital role here. In the first Test, he shepherded the tail and is again on the verge of doing the same. Justifying his selection, Haris! Leans forward and flicks it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single. Raises his bat to the dressing room.
Goes back and punches it through the off side for a single.
Fuller around middle, flicked towards long on for a single.
Goes back to this flatter ball and shows a straight bat.

Edged but safe! Perera tosses it up outside off, it turns away a bit, Sohail makes sure he plays with soft hands. Ekes out an edge which drops short of the man at first slip and rolls further away. They take a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Eases it towards the fielder at mid off.
Drops it near the rough outside off, Sohail leans forward, kills the turn and blocks it safely.
Gets down and brooms it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Comes down the track and eases it through mid on for a single.
Floats it up on middle, defended down watchfully.

FOUR! In the air... safe! Flighted delivery outside off, turning back in, Amir gets down and goes with the spin over mid-wicket. Doesn't time it well but has enough to beat Pradeep in the deep and pick up a boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Goes back and wrists it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! 200 comes up for Pakistan! Tossed up ball from around the wicket, Sohail dances down the track and hits it straight down the ground. The man at long on stood no chance to cut it off.
Darts it around the pads, clipped towards mid on. A wicket maiden from Perera!
Gets behind the line and defends it watchfully.
Slows it through the air this time outside off, blocked into the ground.
Amir is quick to camp back and punch it again towards the off side.
Pushes it quicker through the air outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Mohammad Amir is the next man in! Remember, he is an injured man and won't be bowling in this Test anymore. Now he has to walk in to bat with his side in trouble...

OUT! Sarfraz departs! Perera has his hands aloft! He nicely floats it up outside off, it turns in with a bit of extra bounce. The Pakistan skipper gets down and across to play the sweep shot. The ball goes off the gloves and lobs over the short leg fielder. Kusal Mendis is very alert. He quickly back-pedals and takes it easily. Nigel Llong raises his finger against the appeal that has been made. Sarfraz bangs his bat on the pads in frustration as he trudges back, leaving his side in more trouble, still 84 away from avoiding the follow-on!
Stays put and nudges it with soft hands in the same zone.
Fuller and around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, the batsman makes a bit of room and pushes it through covers for a single.

FOUR! Down the track and boom! Herath gives it a decent amount of air, lands it around off. Sarfraz's eyes light up as he skips down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and goes bang over the bowler's head for a one bounce boundary.
Quicker through the air outside off, Sarfraz makes room, crouches low and cuts it past point for a couple.
Bowls a slider around off, Ahmed nicely lunges forward in defense.
Covers the line and blocks it off the front foot gently.
Presses forward and drives it straight to the man at short cover.
Goes over the wicket to the right-hander, darts it on middle, Sarfraz works it towards mid on and crosses over.
Pushes it quicker through the air outside off, cut towards the point fielder for a single.
Floats it up around off, Haris leans forward and defends it towards cover.
Tossed up from around the wicket, turning away a bit, slapped off the back foot through covers for a comfortable two.
Dilruwan Perera to bowl from the other end!

Huge appeal! Turned down! Herath fires it flat around off, Ahmed gets down to sweep but misses and gets pinged on the pads. The players put in a long and loud appeal but the umpire stays put. The Lankans think for a long time about taking the review but are unable to decide it. Finally the umpire calls time! Hawk Eye shows that it was umpire's call on impact and it just clipped the off pole. Smart decision by the umpire there!
This time works it to long on for one run.
Floated around off and middle, Sohail allows it to spin and works it away to mid-wicket.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Loopy ball outside off, Ahmed hits it to mid off and sets off for and completes a quick run.
Begins by serving a flat ball outside off, Sarfraz slaps it to covers.

It's time for play to get underway for one final time this day. Haris Sohail has his skipper Sarfraz Ahmed for company with the bat. Rangana Herath will start off the proceedings with the ball. There's a slip and a short leg close to the batsman. Let's roll!
DAY 3, SESSION THREE...

Sri Lanka's perseverance with disciplined lines for long periods has reaped rewards. Without being overly fidgety, Chandimal has smartly rotated his bowlers. He hasn't looked desperate and that shows. They would look to continue with their good work as the hosts are still 97 runs adrift of saving the follow-on. Join us in a short while for the final session!

What a session we've had! For most parts of it, Pakistan looked in command but the wicket just before the break changed that. As much as they would have liked Ali to bat on, now they would have to make do without him. Ahmed and Sohail are equally capable to bat for some time and that part of their games has to come out now. Of course, avoiding the follow-on would be their primary target.
Floated in line of the stumps, kept out off the front foot to bring up DINNER, DAY 3!
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Tossed up outside off, Sarfraz gets a thick inside edge towards backward square leg for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.

Not Out! This ball outside off is tapped towards mid off for a quick run. But the fielder there hits the bull's eye at the bowler's end. The umpire referred it upstairs. Replays confirm that Ahmed is well in. One run added to the score.
Howzatt? There is a direct hit at the bowler's end. Third umpire is called for a run out appeal.
Tossed up around off, Ahmed charges down and plays it through mid on for a run.
This is flicked past short leg.
Served in line of the stumps, swept through backward square leg for a run.
This ball is punched towards covers off the back foot.
Skipper Sarfraz Ahmed walks out to bat next.

OUT! Herath cannot be kept away from the wickets for long! Ali is the veteran's bunny yet again as he is dismissed by the bowler for the 10th time in Tests, the most by any bowler! Herath slides this with the arm around off, Ali lunges forward to play for the non-existent turn. Misses the ball and gets struck on the front pad. It looks pretty adjacent, but for some reason, the umpire doesn't think so originally. Herath convinces his skipper to review, who does so after a while. Once the Snicko confirms that there is no inside edge, Hawk Eye displays three reds, meaning the end of Azhar for now. Big wicket as the Pakistani batter has the habit of batting for long periods once he gets set. Half the home side is back in the hut now. They trail by 103!
Azhar Ali has got struck on his pads, the players appeal. The umpire stays put. After a lonnng wait, Chandimal decides to review!
Landed outside off, driven to covers.
Flatter outside off, Azhar paddles it fine. The ball rolls over towards fine leg before Perera runs to his right to get there. Two runs the result.
Looped up around middle, paddled away through short fine leg for a run.
Bunted off the front foot onto the ground.
Around middle and leg, turned to short leg.
Bowled in line of the stumps, solidly defended by showing the full face of the bat.
Floated around middle, turned defensively to mid-wicket.
Outside off, driven to long off for one run.
This ball is played from within the crease.
Floated around off, Ali charges down and goes inside out. Sadeera there puts in the dive to prevent any run.
Landed in line of the stumps, blocked off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! And now the confidence is seeping through! Ali uses his feet to dance down the track to this tossed up ball. Bashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary. The umpires checked whether it traveled the distance but it did land in front of the ropes.
Pushed to the covers off the front foot.
Rangana Herath back on.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Quicker in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot.

27th Test fifty for Azhar Ali! He's stood up for the side when it needed the most. And most importantly, he's seen off the difficult times that he encountered at the beginning of his innings. Ball - served outside off, driven through cover-point for three runs as Chandimal saved a run by chasing it down.
Worked past the short leg fielder, stopped by the fielder at mid-wicket.
Similar delivery, this time it is pushed defensively towards the bowler.
Perera lands it around middle and leg, Ali blocks it off the front foot.
Pushed outside off, Haris leaves it alone.
Angled across the batsman, he drives it to mid off.
Now Pradeep switches to over the wicket and bangs in a bouncer around leg. Sohail evades it by ducking under it.
This is bowled full outside off, kept out watchfully from the crease.
Nuwan runs in from round the wicket and lands it on a length. The batsman defends it from the crease.
On a length around middle, flicked to the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, turned past short leg.
Landed in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
FOUR! Sohail seldom misses out on opportunities to score! This was speared short outside off, Haris goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Tossed up around middle, Haris charges down to block it. The silly point fielder rushes to the ball and flicks it back to the keeper.
Well bowled! It is flatter and quicker around middle, skids onto the batsman. Sohail gets his bat down in the nick of time to keep it out.
Perera comes from round the wicket and serves it on the pads. Gets some turn but Ali plays it past short leg for a run.
On a length and outside off, HS comes forward a touch and defends it down again.
Keeps it in the channel outside off, Sohail lunges forward and defends.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Haris takes the evasive action as he ducks under it.
Fuller delivery, just outside off, Sohail leans forward and pushes it off the middle of the bat. Gets it through covers and comes back for a brace. Good running!
Good length delivery on middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Pradeep angles in a fuller length delivery from outside off, Ali gets across and bunts it down to mid on.
Loopy delivery outside off, Sohail defends it down watchfully.
Flighted delivery around middle and off, blocked off the front foot gently.
Beautifully bowled! Perera loops it up outside off, Sohail lunges forward to defend but the ball straightens a bit to beat the outside edge of Haris' bat.
Steps out and works it wide of mid on for a single.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and flicks it towards mid-wicket where the fielder dives to his right and half stops it.

Brings up the 50-run stand! These two have battled out really well for Pakistan given that they were in real trouble earlier. Tossed up around leg, Azhar flicks it past short leg and comes back for a couple.
Now bangs in a short one down the leg side, HS ducks and lets it go.
And Pradeep is wasting his efforts. Doesn't bowl it even remotely close to the stumps. Haris lets it be.
Lands it on a length well outside off, Sohail doesn't bother playing that.
Full ball outside off, Sohail covers the stumps and shoulders arms.
Hurled in line of the stumps, knocked through mid-wicket for one run.
Pradeep spears this on a length around the off stick. Ali punches it back to the right of the bowler, who stops it in his followthrough.
Now Azhar knocks this delivery down to long on for a run.
Serves it outside off, Ali uses his feet and pushes it towards the bowler.
Sohail works this through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated in line of the stumps, solidly defended off the front foot.
This ball is worked through square leg for one run.
Flatter in line of the stumps, flicked to short leg.
Bowled outside off, left alone.
The crowd has gone vocal! They are shouting 'aram se khelo, dhyan se khelo, jam ke khelo' with respect to Pakistan, which means play with ease, caution and solidity!
Fuller around off, driven through mid on.
This ball is defended off the front foot onto the ground.
FOUR! Deft and pristine! It is on a length outside off, Sohail watches it keenly and uses the pace to play it through point for a boundary.
This ball is pushed towards covers.
Pradeep runs in from round the wicket and serves it full around off. Blocked off the front foot.
Nuwan Pradeep back on for another burst.
Floated around off and middle, bunted off the front foot onto the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

The fact that off spinners are more effective against left handers is stressed when we have a glance at Perera's bowling average. It is around 25 against the lefties as opposed to about 40 against right-handed batters.
Loopy ball outside off, Sohail gets a thick edge past slip as he prods forward. One run taken.
Hurls it shorter outside off, cut straight to the cover-point fielder.
Tossed up ball around off, Ali dances down to play it to the deepish mid on fielder for a run.
Serves a fuller ball around off, Ali gets a big stride forward and pushes it back to the bowler.

Time for drinks! Pakistan have done well to see off a period of play without losing a wicket. Perhaps both batsmen have looked steady without overly attacking has worked for them so far. Sri Lanka though, don't seem to be bothered as they believe a wicket is round the corner. The bowlers haven't looked lackluster which is good. A refreshing, timely break, indeed, for the players!
Sweet! Pushed fuller outside off, Sohail times the cover drive perfectly. Samarawickrama and Chandimal chase the ball but the latter hunts it down and restricts the batsmen to a brace.
Fuller ball around off makes the batsman play! Driven to the fielder at mid off.
Lakmal changes side again! Comes around and lands it outside off, Sohail covers the stump and points his bat up to let the ball pass.
This one is served across the batsman, HS shoulders arms to let that go. The ball goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Now he comes over the wicket and angles it around off and middle.The batsman defends off the front foot.
Suranga steams in from round the wicket and hurls it outside off. Left alone by Sohail.
Haris flicks it off his pads in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Landed around off and middle, Sohail gets low down to defend that.
This ball is driven to covers.
Tossed up ball around off, Ali charges down to whip it to the right of mid on. The fielder gets there but fumbles to allow them the quick run easily.
Loopy ball outside off, tapped towards point for a run.
Flatter around off, defended off the front foot.

A big appeal! A touch fuller outside off, Ali strides forward to defend but ends up offering the pad. The ball strikes it which draws an appeal from the fielding side. The umpire stays put though. Hawk Eye confirms that the ball and the stumps had the universe between!
Lakmal shifts to over the wicket and hurls it around the off stick. Ali gets his bat in the way to block it.
Good length ball outside off, slapped towards cover-point for a quickly run single.
On a length outside off, dabbed towards cover-point.
This ball is outside off, played with an angled bat towards backward point.
Lakmal continues round the wicket and bowls it fuller around off. Haris drives it back to the bowler. Suranga collects it and throws it back to the keeper.
This one is landed well outside off, Ali blocks it with hard hands.
Flatter on the pads, turned away through mid-wicket for one run.
Azhar gets a run. He plays it with the spin towards long on.
Now Ali walks down the track to bunt it with the spin to the on side.
This one's tossed up around off, Ali gets to the pitch and pushes it towards the bowler.
Pushed quicker around off and middle, Ali gets back and punches it towards mid on. A slight misfield there, but nothing conceded.

Dilruwan Perera is summoned in to bowl now. Two reasons for this - one, Herath did bowl for a while now and two, he was picked quite easily by both the batsmen. The previous over could have been the final nail for a while.
A tad fuller around off, Sohail looks to defend but gets it off the outer half towards point.
Length ball around off, punched towards covers.
Served on a length outside off, Haris doesn't bother fiddling with that.
Fuller ball around off, Sohail offers a solid front foot defense.
This ball is too wide of the stumps to make him play.
Beaten! Length ball outside off, Sohail pokes at it and misses. The ball wasn't too far from the edge of the bat. Needs to be careful as his side cannot afford to lose another wicket at this stage.
Ali presents a solid front foot defense to this delivery which is bowled in line of the stumps.
Now he collects a single after knocking it through mid on.
SIX! Sohail hit a six off his second ball and now post that in his 45th ball that he has faced. Herath loops it up outside off, Haris charges down and smashes it over long off for a biggie.
Served outside off, Ali drives it towards covers and collects a quick run.

FOUR! Wow! Azhar Ali has a wonderful style of dealing with Rangana Herath's slow left arm bowling. Looks good when it comes off. Tossed up full outside off, Ali gets to the pitch of the ball and square drives it through point for a boundary.
Floated around off, driven to the fielder at covers.
Another ball outside off, not fiddled with.

The on-air commentators are talking about the delivery strides. Waqar Younis says that since he had a slingy action, his body rhythm took him more towards the danger area and so he had to put in some extra effort to drag himself off that area. In comparison, Lakmal's action naturally takes him to his left, which is safely away from the forbidden area on the pitch.
This is bowled well outside off, Haris lets it be.
Lakmal comes round the wicket and serves it just outside off. Sohail feels for it but finds the ball whiz past the edge of the bat and through to the keeper.
Hurled outside off, Sohail covers the stumps and lets the ball pass through.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Runs in and hurls it on a fuller length around off, Sohail takes a stride forward and defends.
Suranga Lakmal is back on for another spell.
Tossed up ball outside off, Sohail strides forward to defend but gets it off the outer half towards backward point for a quick run. The slip fielder went there to retrieve it.
Floated around off, blocked after lunging forward.
This ball is bunted onto the ground.
Loopy ball around off and middle, Haris blocks it off the front foot.
Served in the line of the stumps, Azhar collects a single after sweeping it through backward square leg.
Herath drops it short around off, Ali cuts it towards backward point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
This ball outside off is guided towards point.
Another ball outside off is left alone. Another no ball as Gamage has overstepped yet again.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Hurled well outside off, left alone. It's called a no ball as Lahiru overstepped.

Not Out! Sohail is well in, indeed! It was a length ball outside off, Ali taps it towards point and sets off for a run. Lakmal gets there and hurls a direct hit at the striker's end. Just to be sure, Llong refers it to the third umpire. Replays confirm the same. One run added to the score. Haris ran a bit wide and so this doubt was created. Had he run in straight lines, he could have been even more in.
There is a direct hit at the striker's end and like all such ones, the umpire chooses to refer it to the third umpire. The batsman looks to be in.
Hurled around off, Ali drives it to the cover fielder.

Various bowlers have their own ways of starting their run-ups. The newcomer Gamage has his own. He throws the ball up with his right hand, catches it and kisses it, before running into bowl. Interestingly though, he does this all with a straight seam!
Lands it full around off, Ali defends it off the front foot onto the ground.
This ball is flicked past short leg.
This ball is defended by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Floated around off and middle, knocked towards mid-wicket.
Served in line of the stumps, turned towards mid-wicket.
Ali sweeps it through backward square leg for one run.

Ouch! That is hit at Mendis at silly point! The ball lobs up and goes towards cover-point. No runs conceded though. It was a tossed up delivery outside off which Ali drove after getting to the pitch of the ball.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Beaten! Gamage lands it a bit fuller and closer to the stumps. Sohail feels for it and gets beaten.
The no-play game continues as Haris points his bats skywards and lets the keeper do the rest.
Similar delivery that is outside off, Sohail covers his stumps and lets it through.
Another ball outside off is left alone. Gamage overstepped and hence it is a no ball.
There's some rough outside the left hander's off stump. This means that these are going to be tough times for the batsmen, with two potent spinners in the ranks of the opposition.
Hurls it well outside off, Haris lets that one go to the keeper.
Gamage comes round the wicket to the lefty and lands it around off. The batsman blocks it off the front foot.
This ball is played with soft hands towards covers. The batsman take a quick run before the fielder gets there.
Flatter in line of the stumps, Haris watchfully keeps it out.
This ball is defended off the front foot onto the ground.
This one turns in a bit more. Sohail gets it off the inside half of the bat past short leg.
Quicker around middle and leg, kept out off the front foot.
Tossed up ball outside off, Sohail allows it to turn and defends it off the front foot.
Pitched further up to the batsman, the batter drives it nicely, but finds the man at covers.
Length ball outside off, Ali stays on the back foot and punches it towards covers.
Back of a length around middle and leg, Azhar crouches low to duck under that and lets it go.
Fuller ball outside off, driven to the cover fielder.
Angling on the pads, Haris works it behind square on the leg side for one run.
Starts round the wicket and lands it on a length around off. Sohail stays in the crease and defends it to the off side.
Lahiru Gamage to bowl from the other end. 10-2-24-1 read his figures.
Floated in line of the stumps, turned through mid-wicket for one run.
Flatter in line of the stumps, played from within the crease.
Drops it outside off, Ali goes back and slaps it through covers for one.
This ball is flicked away through mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Starts off with a tossed up ball around off and middle. Haris stays in the crease and flicks it to mid-wicket.
The men who matter make their way out to the middle. Azhar Ali and Haris Sohail will resume with the bat. Rangana Herath will begin the proceedings with the ball. A slip and a short leg in place.
DAY 3, SESSION TWO...

Pakistan would want and they need a grafting and hard-working innings from the batsmen left. Azhar Ali is still out there and he should look to use his experience to bail his side out from the mess they find themselves in. The hosts' strategy is to attack the bowlers, and when that is backfiring big time, do they have another plan to stay relevant and get to parity? They need 168 more to avoid the follow-on, will they? Join us in a while to know more!

Sri Lanka continue to boss around! Only one thing would have been in their mind - wickets - and they have picked four already. On a slightly helpful track, the touring bowlers have continued to hit the right spots and boy, have they reaped rewards! The openers of Pakistan departed in quick succession and post that, it was just a procession.
Full ball around off, Ali drives it down the ground. Herath gets there from mid on to field it. That's TEA, DAY 3!
Fuller outside off, driven to mid off.
Ali is solid as he punches this off the back foot towards covers.
Fuller delivery angling down the leg side, Azhar looks to flick but misses.
This is in line of the stumps, pushed to mid on.
Pradeep runs in and hurls a length delivery outside off, Ali shoulders arm to that.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Flatter and sliding down the leg side, Sohail doesn't bother playing that.
Flatter around off, met with a solid front foot defense.
SIX! Off the mark in style! Herath gives some more air to that one, Sohail charges down, gets to the pitch of the ball and belts it over long on for a maximum. The first biggie of the innings!
Floated around off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Haris Sohail is the next batsman at the crease.

OUT! Is it a catching practice session or what? Among Herath's 400-plus wickets, this might be the easiest one he would have got. He bowls a loopy ball around middle and leg, a tad shortish, the ball bounces a bit more. Azam goes back to hit it over mid-wicket but picks out the man stationed there, Samarawickrama, perfectly. So Azam's horrid run continues as the veteran adds one more to his kitty. The hosts slip further.
Returns to over the wicket and bowls it full outside off. Ali shoulders arms and lets it go.
Comes round the wicket and lands it on a length around off, Azam taps it towards point and rushes across for a quick single. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Short outside off, Ali stays back and cuts it in front of point. They get three runs even before the fielder chases it down and retrieves the ball.
Back over the wicket, Nuwan lands it around off, Ali stays in the crease and defends it.
Served on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Pradeep runs in from round the wicket and hurls it on a good length around middle and off. The ball stays a tad low, even as Azam manages to get his bat there in time.
Tossed up outside off again, Ali charges down and drives it through covers. A spirited dive by the fielder there prevents a run.
Loopy ball is defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Ali defends this one by getting right behind the line of the ball.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball.
FOUR! Inside out over extra covers! Herath tosses it up outside off, Ali charges down to make room and plays it over the off side for a boundary.
A tad shortish in line of the stumps, Ali goes back and punches it straight.
Landed outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Azam drives this ball to the mid on fielder.
On a length outside off, Azam takes his stride out and defends it of the front foot.
Similar sequence of actions to this delivery, like the previous one.
Landed in line of the stumps, bunted off the front foot.
Bowls it around off, Azam defends it off his front foot onto the ground.
Nuwan Pradeep to roll his arm over.

This is bowled down the leg side, Ali looks to flick but he misses. The ball lobs up off the keeper's gloves and lands between the keeper and the short leg fielder. Both of them didn't know where the ball was and were searching for the same. The keeper was nearer to it though. Snicko shows some murmurs as the ball passes the bat.
Herath bowls it with a side-arm action, the ball goes straight on without spinning. Azam looks to defend but gets an inside edge past short leg for a run.
Dropped in line of the stumps, Babar blocks it off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A tad flatter outside off, punched towards covers. There's a slight misfield there but doesn't result into a run.

Rangana tosses it up around off, Ali charges down and pushes it towards mid off. He runs with the shot which makes it easy for him to complete the run, in spite of a throw from the fielder which missed the stumps.
Bowls it around middle and off, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! Smart bowling by Lakmal but the result doesn't show that! The leg gully is still in place and hence the bowler hurls it a tad fuller on the pads. Azam, as a batsman's habit is, clips it off his pads. But he gets very little bat on that which means the ball flies well away from the fielder in place and rushes away to the fence.
On a length outside off, Ali stays in the crease and taps it to the cover-point fielder.
With a leg gully and square leg in place, Lakmal hurls it on the pads. Ali knocks it to the latter on the leg side.
Similar ball in line of the stumps, Ali knocks it though mid-wicket for one run.
Speared on a length around middle and leg, Azam whips it away through mid-wicket for a run that gets him off the mark.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Herath drops it in line of the stumps, Azhar blocks it.
A front foot defense showing the full face of the bat is displayed to that ball by Ali.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball around off, driven to covers.
Ali pushes it to the fielder at covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Bouncer in line of the stumps, Babar ducks under it.
This ball is defended from within the crease.
Lakmal bowls it fuller around off, Azam keeps it out with a forward defense.
Babar Azam comes in to bat next. He is going through a very lean patch of late and what better time to rectify that. Conversely, he is having a good run in white ball cricket.

OUT! Mendis looked to be in some trouble a while back but no issues in taking this good low catch! Lakmal gets a wicket to his name. He serves it on a length around off, the ball straightens after pitching. Shafiq looks to push at it but the movement means that the ball flies off the edge of the bat to the widish slip, where Mendis gets low to his right first and then grabs it inches off the ground to his left. The umpire asks the leg umpire if it was a clean catch indeed. The latter confirms the same. Although it was a peach of a delivery, Asad could have avoided playing that. He walks back and Pakistan are in real trouble here.
Asad plays this one from within the crease.
The phsyio of Sri Lanka was out there between the overs. Kusal Mendis was in some trouble, inform the on-air commentators.
Floated in line of the stumps, Azhar gets down and just bunts it.
Now Ali charges down the track to block that.
Another loopy ball is pushed back towards the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
This ball is driven back towards the bowler.
Tossed up ball around off and middle, pushed towards covers.
Another delivery that is pitched up around off, Shafiq strides forward to defend.

On the pads, Ali gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls through backward square leg for one run. The leg umpire signaled that there was bat indeed on that, to help his mate at the other end.
Fuller ball around off and middle, it moves in appreciably. Ali pushes it towards mid on.
Another fuller ball around off, driven towards covers.

These two batsmen feature in the list of Pakistanis scoring most runs against Sri Lanka in Tests. Their team would love these two to assert the fact by playing vital knocks here. That, among other things, would help them maintain their clean slate at UAE.
Lakmal drops it on a length around off, Azhar keeps it out of the front foot.
Landed around off, driven off the front foot towards mid off.
This ball is punched back towards the bowler.
Served outside off, pushed to the cover fielder.
Flatter around the off stick, Shafiq negotiates that from the crease.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
This delivery is paddled away aerially, agonizingly closely past short leg for a run. Mendis was the man there. He did react to the direction of the ball but couldn't do much.

FOUR! Awesome Azhar! Herath serves a full flighted ball outside off, Ali lunges forward and drives it powerfully through covers. The ball speeds away to the fence. He is too good a player to miss out on such scoring opportunities.
Landed around off, pushed towards covers.
Fuller ball in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Another ball outside off, shouldered arms to by Shafiq.
This ball is too wide to make Asad play that. Interestingly, it goes on the bounce to Dickwella.
Lakmal bowls it on a length on the pads, Azhar Ali tucks it to deep backward square leg for a run.
An inswinging length ball around off and middle, Shafiq clips it in front of square on the leg side for a single.

Drinks are on the field now! Sri Lanka have done well to send the openers back to the hut in the first hour. Ali and Shafiq have largely looked untroubled but the former is looking a touch fidgety. Needs to calm his nerves.
Similar sequence of actions to this ball as well. A dot ball to end the over.
Floated around off and middle, Ali charges down and defends.
Shafiq drives it towards long off for a run.
Looped up ball in line of the stumps, defended by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Lands it fuller around off, driven to covers.
Rangana Herath is here. Finally. Good for him that two righties are batting.

Aah beauty! Lakmal hurls it full outside off, the ball moved away from the batsman just a touch. Ali looks to go for the drive but ends up only hitting the thin air. Thankfully, he didn't nick that! Ali is really looking fidgety out there!
Suranga spears it outside off, defended by the batsman showing the full bat face.
Bowled in line of the stumps, Ali gets his bat there in the nick of time to push it towards mid on.

In the air... but safe! Lakmal bowls it full outside off, Shafiq drives it uppishly towards mid off. The ball was just wide of the fielder there. And there is a bit of confusion in the running as well! Ali wanted a second even as Asad was ambling across for a run. All's safe in the end, though.
On a length around off and middle, Asad stands tall and defends from the crease.
Lakmal runs in and hurls it fuller around off and middle, Shafiq pushes it to mid on.
FOUR! That's nicely swept! Perera pushes it quicker through the air outside off, Azhar Ali gets down and sweeps it neatly through backward square leg for a boundary to end the over.
Azhar leans ahead and pushes it into the cover region.
Flighted full ball outside off, Ali comes down the track and mistimes his drive towards mid off.
Goes back and clips this flatter ball towards mid-wicket.
Loops it up outside off, Ali wrists it towards mid on.
Floats it up around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Even with two right handers at the crease, Perera continues to bowl. Rangana Herath? Where is he?
Lakmal drops it on a length around off, the batsman stays in the deep and blocks it with a dead bat.
Serves it outside off, Asad covers his sticks and shoulders arms to that. The ball moves in a tad after passing the batsman.
Pitched further up around middle, knocked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Suranga hurls a length delivery that moves away just a little bit. Shafiq stays back and pushes it towards point.
Fuller ball on off, defended off the front foot towards the bowler.
FOUR! Lakmal's welcomed with a boundary! He begins with a delivery that is short and wide of off, Shafiq has plenty of time to go back and cut it over backward point for a boundary.
Suranga Lakmal will have a bowl now.
Now he blocks it off the front foot.
A bit more flight given by Dilruwan, Azhar dances down and blocks.
Now Ali gets to the pitch of the delivery and bunts it onto the ground.
One short mid-wicket is pushed back. He's gone back from a catching position to a run-saving position.
Floats it around off, Ali blocks it lunging forward.
Loopy ball outside off, Ali sweeps it through square leg for a brace.
Perera serves it flatter around off, Ali goes back to defend but edges it towards the slip.
Two short mid-wickets in place. There is a short leg and a slip, too.
Gamage bowls a fuller ball around off, Shafiq plays it from the crease.
On a length outside off, Shafiq shoulders arms to let that go.
Good running. Ali taps it towards mid-wicket and sets off for a quick run. Lahiru runs to field that, but seeing the mid-wicket fielder rush there, he aborts the effort.
Fuller around off, driven back towards the bowler. Gamage gets some hand onto that and makes a half stop, even as the ball rolls past the stumps at the other end.
This is landed around off and middle, AA stays in the crease to defend that off the front foot.
Lahiru runs in and bowls it outside off, Azhar lets it be.
Azhar takes a run after playing it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter around off, pushed to mid on.
Similar delivery outside off, Ali moves across and drives it to the bowler.
The Pakistan batsmen's mindset is so clear with this shot of Ali. Perera tosses this well outside off, but the ball goes straight on. Ali looks to fetch the sweep but misses the ball completely.
Floats it gently around off and middle, Ali knocks it towards mid-wicket.
Looped up around off, turned towards mid-wicket.
Well bowled, Gamage! He spears a yorker around off, Shafiq does well to dig it out.
Lahiru bowls it around off, Shafiq plays it from within the crease.
FOUR! A glorious extravagant cover drive! It was full around off, Shafiq takes a stride forward and plays it through the off side that earns him a deserving boundary.
Dropped on a length in line of the stumps, Asad bunts it off the front foot.
Similar delivery around off, Asad  shows the full face of the bat as he defends it off the front foot.
Landed around off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Tossed up delivery around off, turned to mid-wicket.
Knocked through mid on for a run to get off the mark.

Outside off, Shafiq pushes it towards covers. Ali from the other end, wants a run but is sent back by Asad. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. It could have been interesting had he hit.
Served around off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Asad Shafiq strides out to the center. In the previous day-night Test, he played an almost match-winning century. Needs to play a big innings here.

OUT! Sri Lanka get their second in quick succession! To play back to a spinner, more often than not, is a cardinal sin in cricket. Aslam does just that and it proves fatal. Perera slides it around off, the ball skids off the surface. Sami goes back to flick but misses and is caught in front of the stumps. On appealing, the umpire agrees. The batsman decides to review it. Hawk Eye confirms that it is out indeed. Pakistan lose a wicket as well as a review. Good captaincy by Chandimal to begin with an off spinner with left-handed batsmen at the crease. The hosts are in a spot of bother.
Aslam is ruled out LBW, as he is caught adjacent of the stumps. He decides to review the decision. Looks plumb.
Perera serves it in line of the stumps, Sami goes back and defends.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark. Full ball outside off, Azhar Ali drives it gloriously through covers for a boundary. Brilliantly played.
Lahiru serves it outside off, Ali shoulders arms to that.
This ball is driven back towards the bowler.
Azhar Ali walks into the middle now. He has scored a triple century with the pink ball when he played against the West Indies.

OUT! Knocked him over! Gamage does the damage! He serves it on a length outside off, Masood looks to drive that away from the body. The ball nips in a tad and Shan ends up getting an inside edge that crashes onto the stumps. This ball was a touch fuller than the previous one and that made the difference. Masood looked a bit uncharacteristic with that shot of his. End of the 61-run opening stand.

An appeal but turned down! Gamage lands a length delivery outside off, it nipped back in. Masood moves across and looks to flick. Ends up wearing on the pads. The umpire stays put, as the impact could be well outside off.
Lahiru continues round the wicket and lands it fuller around off. Shan stays in  the crease and defends.
FOUR! Up and over! Perera is gracious in tossing up the cherry outside off, Aslam charges down, makes room and hits it over mid off for a boundary. The plan seems to unsettle the spinner early on.
Peach! Aslam gets beaten on the outside as he lunges forward to defend that. The ball spins and hence he missed it.
Floated around middle, Masood dances down, pushes it towards mid on and scurries through for a quick run.
This delivery is played from within the crease.
Looped up ball around off and middle, Masood steps down only to block it.
Tossed up ball around off, Masood lunges forward but gets an outside edge towards point.
Aslam drives this fuller ball back towards the bowler.
Edged but safe! This is bowled on a length outside off, Sami pokes his bat at that. The ball takes the outside edge and goes on the bounce to gully.
This ball around off is blocked from within the crease.
Gamage comes round the wicket and bowls it around off and middle. It is flicked towards mid-wicket.
A wide slip and two gullies in place.

FOUR! Shot! First boundary for the day! Gamage pushes it on a length across the left hander, Aslam stays deep in the crease, watches the ball till the end and guides it through backward point. The ball races away to the fence.
Length delivery around middle, Aslam strides forward and defends with his bat close to his pad.
Serves it around off, Aslam gets a thickish edge that rolls past the diving gully fielder for a run. The first run for the day.
Fuller outside off, driven to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Landed in line of the stumps, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Aslam charges down the track, only to block it.
Loopy ball around middle and off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
A tad fuller around off, defended off the front foot. Back to back maidens to start the day!
Now Kettleborough has a friendly chat with Gamage. Should be about stepping on the forbidden area.
Again lands it outside off, Masood points his bat skywards and lets that go.
Similar ball well away from the off stick, Masood leaves it alone.
There are signs already of Gamage treading on the danger area on the pitch. This is not good for the youngster, though he'd do well to not let it affect his bowling rhythm.
On a length outside off, Masood covers the stumps and lets that go.
Pitched further up around off, Masood times the drive perfectly only to be intercepted by the mid off fielder.
Gamage runs in from over the wicket and spears it in around middle and leg. Masood clips it towards mid-wicket.
Lahiru Gamage will begin the day from the other end. The newcomer looked impressive yesterday in his short burst and he would love to add value to his wickets column soon.
Flatter around off, played from the crease to the off side.
Served around off, Sami blocks it with a stride forward.
Pushed flatter in line of the stumps, Aslam blocks it off the inner half of his bat.
Perera lands it outside off, Sami pushes it towards covers and wants a run, but is sent back by his partner.
Looped up around off, defended off the front foot showing full face of the bat.
Comes round the wicket and bowls it fuller outside off, Aslam drives it straight to the cover fielder.

Everybody has taken their spots on the field. This should be a good time to bat. Sami Aslam and Shan Masood will resume their vigil with the bat. They will have to tackle the foot marks that have developed on the pitch. For the Lankans, it will be Dilruwan Perera, who will begin with the ball first. One slip and a gully to start with. Here we go...

Hello folks! It's Sunday and the pink ball Test between Pakistan and Sri Lanka has entered Day 3! Enough reasons for you to sit back, relax and enjoy the match. Sami Aslam and Shan Masood survived some nervy moments before close of play yesterday. They would look to pile up more runs in order to give their side a good start. Sri Lanka would be delighted with the assistance that their bowlers extracted last night. They would look to make use of the conditions and push the opposition further on the back foot. Today should be the day that could well end up deciding the course of the game. Stay with us for another intriguing day's play.
DAY 3, SESSION ONE...

Pakistan would feel relatively happy after surviving the tricky phase of play. The Lankan new ball bowlers didn't leak too many runs and were disciplined, but it couldn't be translated into wickets. Perera almost had one, when he beat Masood's bat to rap him on the pads. But the tourists didn't review that and hence the wickets column stays blank. They would be buoyed by the purchase their bowlers are extracting from the track and that would be encouraging enough for them, come Day 3! That's it from us today. Join us tomorrow, for what could be a moving day in this Test match. Till then, adios!
Tossed up on middle and off, Masood comes forward and defends it out. STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Pushed through quicker, Masood picks it off his pads and flicks it past the short leg fielder.
Flatter again, quicker in pace, kept out safely.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Sliding in on middle and leg, turned on the leg side.
Flatter around off, knocked into the off side for a single.

Appeal for an lbw! No response from the umpire, that was a close one. Had Sri Lanka not lost a review, they might have considered taking one on this. Slider on middle and leg, raps Masood on the pads as he looks to defend by walking down the track. Maybe it was going down leg, maybe. Hard to tell in real time. But hold up! Replays show that the ball would have gone on to hit the leg stump. Sri Lanka miss out on a wicket. Should have taken the review.
Defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish ball with no spin on this occasion, Shan Masood presents a tight defensive shot.
Patiently waits for the ball to come to him, lets it turn and then defends it down on the off side.
Quicker in pace and around off, fuller in length, Masood leans across to push it on the off side.
Makes use of the feet, dances out and meets the ball with the full face of the bat.
Comes down the track once again, gets close to the pitch and defends.
Straighter one around the off stick, negotiated well.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bit quicker through the air, Aslam dances down the wicket to block.
Floats it up on off, not much turn on this, blocked out back down the track.
Some decent air provided on this, Aslam moves deep inside his crease before working it away to the mid-wicket area.
Rangana Herath is into the attack.
Nicely done. Uses the crease well, gets behind the line perfectly and dead-bats it.
Full on middle and off, it's buried into the track.
Better line. On middle and leg, slight turn, Shan Masood with a reliable defense keeps it out.
Drifting down leg, comfortably nudged towards mid-wicket.
Hint of turn for Perera. Aslam doesn't move at all, waits for the ball to do its thing and then dabs it past second slip for a quick single.
FOUR! Good start to the over for Pakistan. Too full on the stumps, Aslam gets into the position to play the sweep shot. Brooms it behind square leg and picks up a boundary for doing so.

Stifled shout, but even Gamage knew that wouldn't be given out. Pulled out of the appeal almost immediately. Came from around the wicket and angled it in from around off, caught Masood on the front pad but the impact was well outside the line.
Speared full once more, wide outside off, Shan drives it to mid off again.
Darts it full outside off, Shan with a drive to the mid off fielder.
Too wide outside off, no trouble for the batsman to leave it alone.
In the channel outside off, left alone.

Appeal for a run out! Safely home though. Comfortably in. It's hit down to mid off and the single is on. There is a direct hit at the non-striker's end and so the umpire wants to just make sure. Replays confirm Aslam is fine.
Shan Masood has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Stays right behind the line of this one and negotiates with the spin safely.

Sharp turn for Perera! Looped up and it's spinning away, beats the outside edge of Shan Masood's bat before thudding into the keeper's gloves. He didn't collect it cleanly, but no runs conceded. No harm done.
Floated around the off stump, kept out well off the front foot.
This is smart bowling by Dilruwan. Just drags his length back by a fraction, invites Masood to come forward again to drive. The ball spoons off the leading edge and goes safely towards covers.

FOUR! Nicely flicked away by Shan Masood! Full and drifting in on middle, he gets close to the pitch of the ball and wrists it through the left of Rangana Herath at mid on, who can't stop it with a dive. Good shot, didn't try to hit it too hard. Was all about the timing, that.
Back of a length delivery which is kept out on the off side with soft hands.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Swinging away, from a good length, left alone for the keeper to collect.
FOUR! This is good, attacking intent from Aslam! Full and wide outside off, he leans into the shot and crisply drives it through the covers for a boundary.
Length delivery close to off, Aslam while attempting to defend gets an inside edge onto his front pad.
Bowls it outside off, and makes it travel away from Sami Aslam. The batsman is happy to leave it alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Turning away again, on a full length, once again the ball takes the edge and goes through the vacant slip position for a run.
FOUR! Shot! Seeing the added flight, Aslam positions himself early for the slog sweep. Opens his body up and clobbers it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Edged but it's safe! Some sharp turn for Dilruwan as he drops it outside off, Masood is forward to defend but the ball takes the edge and goes past the keeper. Single taken.
Looped up just outside the line of off stump, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Spinning away from around off, Masood looks to defend. He opens the face a bit and plays it off the outer half towards short third man.
Dilruwan Perera to bowl now.
Waits for the ball to come to him, plays it late and dabs it to gully.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Length ball outside off, played to point.

Not out! The on-field decision stays! That's a good call by the umpire. Fuller length delivery on off, it's shaping across as Aslam prods forward to defend. He's caught on the front pad and there's a shout for a leg before. The umpire turns it down so Sri Lanka review as they think Sami is gone. It's taken upstairs and replays show that the ball is clearly missing the off stump. Poor review in hindsight, Sri Lanka lose one of their two.
Review time! Sri Lanka have reviewed a leg before decision against Sami Aslam. He looks to be safe. Let's see what happens here...
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Angles it across, just outside off, the batsman doesn't flirt with it.

Well outside off, it's dropped on a length, Masood reaches across to play at it but the ball brushes his thigh pads and goes behind. There's a muted shout for a caught behind, but it won't be given. Two leg byes are taken as the keeper fails to collect it cleanly.
Lakmal fires this one right up there, Masood drives it to the covers.
Holding its line on the fifth stump line, left alone.
Good length delivery outside off, dabbed to point with an open face.

Confusion in the middle and Pakistan could have lost their first wicket! Shan Masood taps it in front of cover and sets off. His partner is off as well but then Shan decides to abort the run. Lakmal gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at his end. Aslam is struggling to get back and had that hit, he would have been gone. Masood immediately raises his hand to apologize, not sure that'd have counted for much if his partner would have been out.
Around the wicket, length ball outside off, no shot offered.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Aslam has been quite disciplined till now. Gamage wants him to poke at that, it's in the corridor of uncertainty but the opener has resisted.
Just ahead of a length in the off stump channel, kept out well on the off side.
Outward movement again for Gamage, Aslam glides it with a slightly opened face behind point. Two runs are taken.
Lands it on a length, it hits the deck and seams away. Aslam lets it be.
Well done. Masood tucks this in the big gap in the mid-wicket area and will get good runs for this. Three to be precise, big boundary out there.
Brings it in closer, makes the batsman play this time. Aslam meets it with a straight blade.
'Round the wicket to Sami Aslam, it's in the zone of apprehension. Left alone without taking any risks.
Short ball into the body, with a little swivel Shan Masood pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Shaping away from the batsman on a back of a length, Masood withdraws his bat and watches as the ball goes past him.
Harmless length delivery outside off, easy leave for the batsman to make.
Lands it around leg, easy enough for Aslam to nudge it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Fuller length delivery, driven off the inner half back down towards mid on. Good start by Gamage, encouraging signs.
Accurate again. Keeps it around off, on a length, Masood can only prod forward and defend.
Drives this on the up. Connects it right off the meat but hits it straight to extra cover.
Short of a good length quite close to the off stick, Masood stands tall and guards it out from the back foot.
Tap and run stuff from Aslam. Nicely done. Drops it in front of cover-point and scurries across to complete the run.
Down the leg side on a length, Sami looks to nudge it away but misses.

Lahiru Gamage to bowl his first over in Test cricket. Will be interesting to see how he fares. There's movement on offer, best possible conditions for him to put in a good spell. Three slips and a gully in place for him.
Switches to around the wicket for the last ball of the over, angles it in on a fuller length. Aslam leans across and flicks it behind square leg to retain strike.
Fourth leave in a row. well outside off, no need to fiddle with it. So he doesn't bother.
Angling across on a length once again, Sami Aslam with another leave.
Watches the ball closely again, sees there's no threat to him so he raises his bat and lets it go.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Back of a length delivery on the hips, tucked through backward square leg for three good runs.
Fuller ball fired outside off, Sami drives it on the up and pierces the gap through the covers. Chandimal gives it the chase and pulls it inside the rope. Two runs taken.

Taps this just wide of Chandimal at short cover and both batsmen set off. Bit risky as the Lankan skipper is quick to the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Good thing that Masood was just in, otherwise that'd have been bad news for the home side.
Pradeep swings it away from Shan Masood, the batsman plays it away from his body and ends up getting an edge square on the off side.
Good shot, the timing's superb. Sami Aslam leans into the shot nicely as he punch-drives it through mid off. Extra cover chases it down but by this time, the batsmen have already run three.
Closer to the off stump this time but it's still well away, enough for the batsman to leave it alone.
Length delivery well outside off, moving away further, Aslam has nothing to do with it.
Served on a length again, on the fourth stump line, Masood leans ahead and pushes it back down towards mid off. It's just wide of the fielder and the batsmen take two.
Outside off on a good length again, another one left alone.
Well read by Masood. Seeing the ball angling across, he covers the line by planting his front foot across and shoulders his arms to it.

Moving about outside off, this is good stuff from this opening pair. Aslam taps it down in front of point and calls his partner through. He responds quickly and so, the run is completed with ease. Good running.
Length delivery just outside off, seaming off the deck as Aslam opens the face. Dabs it to point but it's straight to the fielder.
Too straight in line and this allows Sami Aslam to work it away on the leg side. He gets it through backward square leg and picks up a couple of runs as the man in the deep cuts it off.
Pradeep goes full again with his length, outside off, Masood plays the drive but finds the short cover fielder. A decent first over by Nuwan.
Again it's served around off on a fuller length, Shan draws forward and pushes it back from the inside half of the bat.
Full and on off, Masood gets forward and defends it to the off side towards mid off.
Good length ball on off, Aslam taps it down to covers and steals a single.
Four byes! Another delivery in the channel outside off, Sami leaves it alone and the keeper fumbles to allow four bonus runs.
Angling away from the batsman, outside off, Aslam allows it through.
Nuwan Pradeep will bowl from the other end.
Straighter in line, Masood stays put and defends it on the leg side. End of a testing first over by Suranga.
Oohh...that came back in a lot more. Just outside off, Masood gets forward and then leaves it. It swings in the air and then moves off the deck as well. Not too far away from the stumps.
Better from Masood this time. It's on a full length outside off, Shan plants his front foot forward to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Nearly edged it! Once again it swings the other way, from a length outside off, Shan has no clue about it. His stance indicates that he was expecting an inswinger. Ends up missing it terribly.
Beaten! Good line by Lakmal. Puts it on a length around off, shaping away a shade, Masood without any footwork feels for it and gets beaten.
Starts with a length ball around off, Masood gets behind the line and defends it back watchfully.
